Your own place in
Vicolo Monteleone

Mont°6 is a self-contained apartment in the pedestrian old town of Cefalù. Two minutes on foot from the Cathedral, five from the beach, thirty seconds from the restaurants.

One bedroom, one bathroom, a proper kitchen, exposed beams and Sicilian tiled floors. Air conditioning throughout, fibre broadband, linens and towels included. You let yourself in with the digital lock, any time from 3pm.

Explore Cefalù

A few places to explore on foot between a swim and dinner.

La Rocca

270 metres up, about 40 minutes. At the top, the ruins of the Norman castle and the gulf.

The Medieval Laundry

A stone staircase drops below street level to the Cefalino river. Two minutes from the door.

The beach

Five minutes on foot. Sand, shallow water, and the fishing harbour at one end.

The Cathedral

Begun in 1131, Byzantine mosaics in the apse. UNESCO listed since 2015.

Before you arrive

Let yourself in with the digital lock from 3:00 PM. Please leave by 10:00 AM on your last day so we can prepare the apartment for the next guests.

Being located in the pedestrian historical center, we recommend parking at "Parcheggio Coco" on the seafront, about a 5-minute walk from us. There is also a ZTL zone for residents.

Unfortunately we cannot accept pets in the property for hygiene and regulatory reasons.

Yes, we provide bed linen, towels, and a basic breakfast product set.

The minimum stay is 2 nights. During high season (July-August) 3 nights may be required.

Cancel up to 14 days before arrival and you get a full refund. Between 14 and 7 days before, the refund is 50%. From 7 days before, and in case of no-show, there is no refund. Refunds go back to the card you paid with, usually within 5-10 working days. To cancel, just message me on WhatsApp or send an email.

No — it is the one thing not included in the total you see here. The Cefalù council charges €2 per person per night, capped at 5 nights, paid in cash on arrival. For two people and three nights that is €12.
